_schema.about: Hand-maintained fallback, used only when https://benchlm.ai/benchmarks/bridgebench (BenchLM's republished snapshot of BridgeBench's overall ratings) cannot be fetched. Copy the scores from https://www.bridgebench.ai/leaderboard in a normal browser. scripts/build_leaderboard.py never contacts bridgebench.ai: it sits behind a bot challenge and its robots.txt disallows /api/.
_schema.source: URL the scores were read from
_schema.transcribed_at: ISO 8601 UTC time the scores were copied, e.g. 2026-10-05T12:00:00Z
_schema.models: [{rank: int (1 = best), name: BridgeBench display name, slug: BridgeBench URL slug, overall: number, axes: {axis_name: number, ...}}]
